## Dependencies

```{r, echo = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)

library(ggsurvfit)

```

## Clinical data

```{r, echo = FALSE}
clinical_cohort <- read_csv("../Data/patients_list_final.csv") #Read in final clinical annotation file

# Factors
clinical_cohort$Race <- factor(clinical_cohort$Race, levels = c("White", "Black", "Other"))
clinical_cohort$msi_tmb_hi <- factor(clinical_cohort$msi_tmb_hi, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Low/Unknown", "High"))
clinical_cohort$treatment_summary <- factor(clinical_cohort$treatment_summary, levels = c("neither", "non-immunotherapy systemic tx", "immunotherapy systemic treatment", "both"), labels = c("Neither", "Non-immunotherapy systemic tx", "Immunotherapy", "Both"))
clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4 <- factor(clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Single", "Combination"))
clinical_cohort$responder <- factor(clinical_cohort$responder, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Non-responder", "Responder"))

# Labels
label(clinical_cohort$msi_tmb_hi) <- "MSI-H or TMB-H"
label(clinical_cohort$treatment_summary) <- "Prior Treatment"
label(clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4) <- "Regimen"
label(clinical_cohort$responder) <- "Response Status"

# Code to compute p-values
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
    # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
    y <- unlist(x)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
        # For numeric variables, perform a Mann-Whitney U test (non-parametric)
        p <- wilcox.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
        # For categorical variables, perform a Fisher's exact test
        p <- fisher.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
    # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
    # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable label.
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
}
```

## Table 1

```{r}
table_1 <- table1(~ `Age On Study` + Gender + Race + `Cancer Type` + treatment_summary + msi_tmb_hi + responder | clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4, data = clinical_cohort, overall = "Total Cohort")

table_1.1 <- table1(~ `Age On Study` + Gender + Race + cancer_type + treatment_summary + msi_tmb_hi + responder | clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4, data = clinical_cohort, overall = "Total Cohort")

table_1_comparison <- table1(~ `Age On Study` + Gender + Race + cancer_type + treatment_summary + msi_tmb_hi + responder | clinical_cohort$anti_ctla4, data = clinical_cohort, overall = FALSE, extra.col = list(`P-value` = pvalue))

# Table 1
table_1
```
